objectives: speak against ... の意味を理解する
make A B（AをBの状態にする）の構造を理解する
not A but B を理解し使える
Signpost / Present Situation / Cause / Seriousness の違いを説明できる
任意化への反対理由を自分の英語で2つ言える
material.script: Good morning. I am speaking against making club activities optional. I will explain the present situation, examine the causes of problems, and show why this motion is dangerous. Currently, most Japanese schools require students to join clubs. This system helps students develop teamwork and discipline. However, some students feel stressed by mandatory participation. The real problem is not that clubs are required, but that schools offer too few choices. Therefore, we should expand club variety rather than make them optional. If clubs become optional, many will close due to lack of members. Students will lose opportunities to develop skills and friendships. Additionally, without clubs, students may spend excessive time on studies, damaging their mental health. Making clubs optional will harm students' development. Instead, we should improve the club system. I ask for your opposition to this motion.
material.script_ja_note: 反対立論。教材の主張は「この立論の主張」として扱い、外部の事実確認は授業の対象外。AI が統計や新しい事実を追加しない。

debate_tasks.prompt: You are against making club activities optional. Give two reasons in your own English.

ai_counterarguments.text: Some students are very busy or stressed. If club activities are optional, they can choose how to use their time. Why should schools require everyone to join a club?

model_answers.core_claim: The problem is not compulsory club participation itself, but the lack of choices. Schools should expand club variety rather than make clubs optional.
model_answers.en_argument: I am against making club activities optional. First, if clubs become optional, many clubs will close because of a lack of members. Second, students will lose opportunities to develop skills and friendships. Therefore, we should improve the club system.

lesson_phases.focus_sentence: Good morning. I am speaking against making club activities optional.
lesson_phases.opening_ja: では始めましょう。今日は学校のクラブ活動についての反対立論を使います。まず最初の文を読みます。

questions.ask_ja: `against` は賛成と反対のどちらですか？
hints: against は方向を表す語で、「〜に向かって逆らう」イメージです。
「賛成」なら for、「反対」なら against です。
questions.confirm_ja: そうです。今日は『クラブ活動を任意にすること』への反対立論です。`speak against ...` で『〜に反対して話す』という意味になります。

lesson_phases.focus_sentence: I am speaking against making club activities optional.

questions.ask_ja: `optional` は、必ずやるという意味ですか、それとも選べるという意味ですか？
hints: option（選択肢）と同じ語のなかまです。
「必ずやる」なら required、「選べる」なら optional です。
questions.confirm_ja: そうです。optional は『任意の、選択できる』ですね。

questions.ask_ja: `making club activities optional` は全体でどういう意味ですか？
accept: クラブ活動を任意にすること
部活を選択制にすること
部活動を任意にすること
クラブを自由参加にすること
hints: `make A B` という形が使われています。
A が club activities、B が optional です。「AをBの状態にする」と考えてみてください。
questions.confirm_ja: はい。`make A B` で『AをBの状態にする』。ここでは『クラブ活動を任意にすること』です。
